name: BUEditor
project_description:
BUEditor is a text editor aiming to facilitate code writing.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Completely customizable editor interface 
 Ability to create buttons with icons or text 
 Per role editor assignments 
 Native support for html tags, bbcode tags, and other markup systems 
 
 Back to top 

 Recommended 
 
 AJAX Markup (Not needed with Drupal 8 version) 

Provides ajax previewing of non-html markup such as bbcode, markdown, etc.

Change your preview button's content to: js: E.prvAjax(); to activate it. 
 BUEditor Plus (Not needed with Drupal 8 version) 

Assigns editors to input formats, which allows BUEditor to be used interchangeably with WYSIWYG module. 
 Markdown editor for BUEditor 

Provides a toolbar for Markdown and Markdown Extra markup.
